components.name: Button
components.summary: A clear action, with a native focus ring.
components.behavior: User activation invokes on_action; cui_activate invokes the same action synchronously and respects enabled and visible ancestors.
components.limitations: The PRIMARY role is a semantic style, not a custom color API.

components.name: Icon assets
components.summary: Your vector artwork, sharp at every display scale.
components.behavior: Reusable, reference-counted vector and RGBA assets; compiled SVG import, system raster loading and optional symbols. Standalone views fit the asset proportionally in logical units.
components.limitations: SVG import is build-time and rejects unsupported document features. Asset references require explicit release. Raster resolution is limited by its source.

components.name: Icon button
components.summary: Native actions with vector artwork and accessible names.
components.behavior: Icon-only buttons keep native keyboard, focus and action semantics. Ordinary buttons and toggles accept leading icons and can switch to icon-only presentation. Widgets retain assigned assets.
components.limitations: A nonempty accessible name is required for icon-only buttons. Appearance follows native foreground colors; explicit asset colors are preserved.

components.name: Label & typography
components.summary: Hierarchy built with system typography.
components.behavior: Use BODY, TITLE, HEADING and CAPTION roles. Fonts inherit from containers; explicit font overrides are supported.
components.limitations: Installed fonts determine glyph coverage. Labels are not a rich text renderer.

components.name: Text entry
components.summary: Single-line editing with native selection and IME.
components.behavior: Read the full UTF-8 value with the two-call cui_get_text pattern. User edits emit on_action; setting text is silent.
components.limitations: Business validation and persistence belong to the application.

components.name: Password
components.summary: A masked native text entry.
components.behavior: Read the full UTF-8 value with the two-call cui_get_text pattern. User edits emit on_action; setting text is silent.
components.limitations: Business validation and persistence belong to the application.

components.name: Search field
components.summary: A native text field for application search.
components.behavior: Read the full UTF-8 value with the two-call cui_get_text pattern. User edits emit on_action; setting text is silent.
components.limitations: Business validation and persistence belong to the application.

components.name: Text area
components.summary: Multiline editing with native text behavior.
components.behavior: Read the full UTF-8 value with the two-call cui_get_text pattern. User edits emit on_action; setting text is silent. The preferred height can be adjusted from 24 to 2048 logical units for growing composers. Navigation key callbacks can consume Enter or Escape while active IME composition retains its keys.
components.limitations: Business validation and persistence belong to the application.

components.name: Code surface
components.summary: Selectable monospace text with native rendering.
components.behavior: Read the full UTF-8 value with the two-call cui_get_text pattern. User edits emit on_action; setting text is silent.
components.limitations: Code is read-only and has no syntax highlighting.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A native boolean choice.
components.behavior: Read checked state in on_action; cui_set_checked updates state without emitting an action.
components.limitations: Keep the label meaningful when read independently.

components.name: Toggle button
components.summary: A native boolean choice.
components.behavior: Read checked state in on_action; cui_set_checked updates state without emitting an action.
components.limitations: Keep the label meaningful when read independently.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A native boolean choice.
components.behavior: Read checked state in on_action; cui_set_checked updates state without emitting an action.
components.limitations: Keep the label meaningful when read independently.

components.name: Radio group
components.summary: One choice from a small set.
components.behavior: Radio controls sharing an immediate parent form one exclusive group.
components.limitations: Separate groups must have distinct parent boxes.

components.name: Dropdown
components.summary: A compact choice model with copied text.
components.behavior: Use zero-based selected indices; -1 clears selection. Replacing items clears selection.
components.limitations: Items are strings; rich cells and icons are not part of this API.

components.name: List
components.summary: A compact choice model with copied text.
components.behavior: Use zero-based selected indices; -1 clears selection. Replacing items clears selection.
components.limitations: Items are strings; rich cells and icons are not part of this API.

components.name: Data table
components.summary: Editable, sortable, native rows.
components.behavior: Enable editing by column, select multiple rows and sort by text or finite numeric values. Map displayed rows back to source indices after sorting.
components.limitations: Rows are copied in memory. Lazy providers, rich cells and reordering remain. GTK header clicks need 4.10; programmatic sorting works with 4.6.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: Adjust a value smoothly.
components.behavior: Values are normalized to 0…1; finite out-of-range values clamp. Map this range to your own units in the application.
components.limitations: Use a numeric input when users must enter an exact value.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Show measurable work.
components.behavior: Set a normalized value between 0 and 1 as application work advances.
components.limitations: The application supplies progress; no worker thread is created.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Indicate work without a known duration.
components.behavior: The native indicator animates while shown; hide it when work completes.
components.limitations: Provide a textual description and a cancellation action where useful.

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A quiet boundary between related sections.
components.behavior: A native separator participates in the containing layout.
components.limitations: Use labels and spacing to retain structure beyond a visual rule.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Compact semantic status.
components.behavior: Tone uses semantic roles and follows the application theme. Text is copied and may be replaced.
components.limitations: A badge is display content, not an action.

components.name: Line chart
components.summary: Native vector drawing that stays sharp.
components.behavior: Supply copied numeric series and replace them with cui_chart_set_values.
components.limitations: The current chart has no rich accessibility model or axis/legend API.

components.name: RGBA image
components.summary: Your pixels, rendered on a native surface.
components.behavior: cui_image_set_rgba copies tightly packed RGBA8 data and preserves its aspect ratio when drawing.
components.limitations: Maximum source size is 4096×4096. Image decoding, capture and networking belong to the application.

components.name: Rows & columns
components.summary: Content-driven layout with flexible space.
components.behavior: Children append in keyboard/layout order. Padding and gaps are logical units; expanding children share spare space.
components.limitations: Native minimum sizes are preserved. Enable window scrolling for oversized content.

components.name: Layered stack
components.summary: Compose dialogs, floating panels and notices inside one native window.
components.behavior: The first layer fills the base; later layers overlap in insertion order with fill, center, top, bottom or bottom-right alignment. Each layer contains ordinary CUI controls. Hiding a layer preserves its state.
components.limitations: Applications own dismissal, modality and focus restoration. Preferred overlay sizes must fit the content; GTK honors native minimum sizes. No built-in backdrop blur or shadow.

components.name: Grid
components.summary: Structured forms with rows, columns and spans.
components.behavior: Each grid cell is an owned box; coordinates are zero-based and spans must not overlap.
components.limitations: Maximum 64 columns and 256 rows. Invalid spans return NULL.

components.name: Wrapping row
components.summary: Controls that reflow as space changes.
components.behavior: The row recomputes line breaks from available width and native child minimums.
components.limitations: This is a wrapping row, not a CSS layout engine.

components.name: Split panes
components.summary: Give users control of their workspace.
components.behavior: The divider supports pointer and keyboard adjustment. Observe user changes on the split root; set_position is silent.
components.limitations: Each of the two panes is a normal owned box. Native minimum sizes constrain available positions.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Keep related views in one place.
components.behavior: Add titled pages with cui_tab_add; each page is a parent box. Selected-page changes use the normal composed-control behavior.
components.limitations: Tabs use buttons and boxes. Dedicated native tab semantics and a screen-reader audit remain.

components.name: Disclosure
components.summary: Details when you need them.
components.behavior: Use the content box for child widgets; expanded state can be read or set without replacing internal callbacks.
components.limitations: This is a composed control built from native buttons and boxes.

components.name: Tree
components.summary: Hierarchical models with stable IDs.
components.behavior: Parents precede children; IDs are unique and nonzero. Selection opens ancestors, and replacement clears selection. User events distinguish select, expand, collapse and activate.
components.limitations: At most 65,536 items and 128 levels. Single selection; icons and lazy child providers remain.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: An actionable path to the current location.
components.behavior: Ancestors are focusable buttons; the final segment is a label. Read the activated ID and let the application update its navigation state.
components.limitations: Up to 128 unique nonzero IDs. Replacement is silent and resets the activated ID.

components.name: Numeric input
components.summary: Precise values with native stepper arrows.
components.behavior: Typing commits on Enter or focus loss; arrows commit immediately. Invalid text restores the last committed value. Values round and clamp to configured bounds.
components.limitations: Bounds ±1e9; precision 0…9. Bounds and step must be representable at the chosen precision.

components.name: Date input
components.summary: A civil date in the platform’s own format.
components.behavior: Pass Gregorian year/month/day values; invalid replacements leave the previous date unchanged.
components.limitations: Years 1601…9999. Timezone-free civil values, not timestamps.

components.name: Time input
components.summary: A native wall-clock time.
components.behavior: Pass hour/minute/second values and read the committed value through cui_time_get.
components.limitations: Values are timezone-free and use 24-hour fields regardless of displayed locale formatting.

components.name: Validation field
components.summary: A label, useful help, and an inline error.
components.behavior: Listen on the field root to validate user edits. Set an empty error to clear invalid state. The entry remains available for ordinary setters.
components.limitations: Replacing the internal entry action callback bypasses event forwarding. Business rules belong to the application.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.summary: Find a choice without leaving the keyboard.
components.behavior: Copied choices have stable IDs, details, keywords and disabled state. Unicode search, arrow navigation, Enter, Escape and IME-aware key handling are supported. Result headings, status and action buttons are independently configurable through cui_picker_set_chrome.
components.limitations: Results expand in normal layout flow. This is not a floating popup or modal overlay.

components.name: Command palette
components.summary: Find a choice without leaving the keyboard.
components.behavior: Copied choices have stable IDs, details, keywords and disabled state. Unicode search, arrow navigation, Enter, Escape and IME-aware key handling are supported. Result headings, status and action buttons are independently configurable through cui_picker_set_chrome.
components.limitations: Compose the picker inside a layered stack for an in-window overlay. The application owns input blocking, dismissal and focus restoration.

components.name: Token field
components.summary: Ordered, removable choices that wrap naturally.
components.behavior: A copied choice model backs unique selected IDs. Enter accepts; Backspace on empty input removes the last token. Listen on the root for typed token events.
components.limitations: Selection limit 1…128. Unmatched text emits a submit request; the application validates or creates the choice.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: Useful status with a clear next action.
components.behavior: Reusable and initially hidden. Show copies content; user action, dismiss and expiry have distinct events. Actions do not automatically dismiss.
components.limitations: In-layout region, not an OS notification or floating overlay. Only toast regions accept nonzero timeouts; hover/focus/hidden states pause expiry.

components.name: Toast region
components.summary: Useful status with a clear next action.
components.behavior: Reusable and initially hidden. Show copies content; user action, dismiss and expiry have distinct events. Actions do not automatically dismiss.
components.limitations: In-layout region, not an OS notification or floating overlay. Only toast regions accept nonzero timeouts; hover/focus/hidden states pause expiry.

components.name: Empty state
components.summary: Useful status with a clear next action.
components.behavior: Reusable and initially hidden. Show copies content; user action, dismiss and expiry have distinct events. Actions do not automatically dismiss.
components.limitations: In-layout region, not an OS notification or floating overlay. Only toast regions accept nonzero timeouts; hover/focus/hidden states pause expiry.

components.name: Error state
components.summary: Useful status with a clear next action.
components.behavior: Reusable and initially hidden. Show copies content; user action, dismiss and expiry have distinct events. Actions do not automatically dismiss.
components.limitations: In-layout region, not an OS notification or floating overlay. Only toast regions accept nonzero timeouts; hover/focus/hidden states pause expiry.

components.summary: Choose local files with named filters and multiple selection.
components.behavior: Creation defers opening to the event loop. Check the completion result before reading typed values. Cancellation completes at most once; teardown suppresses callbacks.
components.limitations: Preview shows the working launcher. Click it in the native showcase to open the system dialog; the browser image cannot open a desktop dialog.

components.summary: Shared commands in a compact action row.
components.behavior: Menus, shortcuts and toolbar buttons share each command’s enabled and checked state. PRIMARY maps to Command on macOS and Control elsewhere.
components.limitations: Commands are application-owned; callback context must remain valid through app teardown.

components.name: Menus & context menus
components.summary: One command model across desktop actions.
components.behavior: Menu bars contain named submenus; context menus open at a widget anchor. macOS preserves standard application and editing actions.
components.limitations: Preview shows the menu launcher. Run the native example to interact with the actual menu.

components.name: Loading State
components.summary: Spinner, elapsed timer, progress, cancel action
components.behavior: Spinner, elapsed timer, progress, cancel action. Listen on the root and preserve internal callbacks. Model setters are silent; see the Pattern data models guide for detailed contracts.
components.limitations: Application reports progress and cancels its work

components.name: Thinking

components.behavior: Expandable trace and selectable text. Listen on the root and preserve internal callbacks. Model setters are silent; see the Pattern data models guide for detailed contracts.

components.name: Canvas & compositing
components.summary: Custom controls, layered color and translucent materials.
components.behavior: Transactional RGBA surfaces with native text and icon rasterization, group alpha, rounded clips, blur and labeled interaction regions. Canvas copies the displayed frame and retains the source surface. Query the allocated size for responsive redraws, measure native single-line text for custom wrapping, and handle navigation keys for independently scrolling views.
components.limitations: CPU renderer; fixed surface dimensions/scale. Text is single-line with ellipsis. Native child-widget opacity varies by backend. No desktop backdrop capture or GPU context.
